data.text: I’m in: 15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, provided John and Jack join us so the full $60,000 reaches it today. My family taught me to protect the lake that feeds our village; this exception needs to stay an exception. I agree to no more than 6 tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap, then 10 tons each once the lake is back at 100. John, will you join Kate and me?
